_doc: The winter special sites (bead bzc.87, docs/art/classes/map-objects.md): generate-image-v2 at native display size, 1x1 sites on 64 x 64, 2x2 sites on 128 x 128; one call returns several candidates. Layers: style, light-south-west, class-map-object, subject; the imported sawmill is the style image for outline, pixel size and viewing angle only (as set map-objects). Recipes are never edited after generation: add a new id (new seed) instead.

styleSawmill.usage: copy only the thick black outline, the pixel size, the flat shading with one shadow tone and the slightly-from-above front viewing angle; not the subject, not the colours and not the layout

recipes.subject: Subject: a frost giant's barrow, a creature bank: a big burial mound of packed snow and pale blue ice #9fd0ea with a dark doorway framed by huge grey standing slabs #7a808c at the front, icicles hanging off the lintel, a giant horned iron helmet and a broken frosted axe on top of the mound, each image a different size of it: a small modest one, a medium one, a large grand one, and another large grand one. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, ground, grass, snow plate, flag

recipes.subject: Subject: an aurora spire: a tall slender spire of pale blue ice crystal #bfe6f6 rising from a small ring of frosted grey stones, its tip glowing with soft green #6ef0b0 and violet #b07ef0 aurora light that ripples down its faces. About half of the image wide and nearly the full image tall, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, ground, grass, snow plate, flag, sky, cloud

recipes.subject: Subject: a snowy hunter's lodge: a sturdy log cabin of dark brown logs #6a4428 with a steep roof thick with snow, a stone chimney, a big pair of antlers over the front door, crossed skis and two round snowshoes leaning by the door, a rack of drying furs at the side. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, animal, ground, grass, snow plate, smoke, flag

recipes.subject: Subject: a walrus rookery, the den of the rime walruses: a big low dome of pale blue ice blocks #a8d8f0 like a giant igloo with a wide dark entrance at the front, two huge curved ivory walrus tusks #ece0c4 crossed over the entrance, a wooden rack of frozen fish beside it and a pile of snow at its side. Nearly the full image wide and most of its height, its front facing the viewer straight on.
recipes.negative: person, ground, grass, snow plate, flag, water
